scenarios.title: Milling moves that many cards from the top of the library to the graveyard

setup.notes: Libraries are listed top card first.

decisions: A casts Mind Sculpt targeting B, tapping both Islands.
B passes; both players pass and Mind Sculpt resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: B mills seven cards: the seven Islands move from the top of B's library to B's graveyard, in order. B's library holds the three Forests.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell on Mind Sculpt, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Mind Sculpt is countered and goes to A's graveyard. B's library keeps all ten cards and B's graveyard stays empty.

scenarios.title: A player mills as many cards as possible when instructed to mill more than the library holds

setup.notes: Libraries are listed top card first.

decisions: A casts Mind Sculpt targeting B, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Mind Sculpt resolves.

variants.label: short_library
variants.expected: B mills as many cards as possible: Forest, Island and Swamp move to B's graveyard and B's library is empty. B has not lost the game yet.

variants.label: empty_library
variants.expected: No card is milled. B's graveyard stays empty.

variants.label: long_library
variants.delta: B's library holds ten cards (Forest, Island, Swamp, then seven Mountains).
variants.expected: B mills exactly seven cards: Forest, Island, Swamp and four Mountains move to B's graveyard and three Mountains remain in B's library.

scenarios.title: A cost that mills more cards than the library holds cannot be paid
decisions: A considers activating Rot Farm Skeleton's graveyard ability ({2}{B}{G}, mill four cards), paying the mana with the four lands.

variants.label: library_of_four
variants.expected: A may activate the ability: the mill cost can be paid with four cards in the library. The four Islands move to A's graveyard and Rot Farm Skeleton returns to the battlefield.

variants.label: library_of_three
variants.expected: A cannot activate the ability, because a cost of milling four cards cannot be paid with three cards in the library. Nothing is milled and Rot Farm Skeleton stays in the graveyard.

scenarios.forge_notes: The activation is sorcery speed from the graveyard; the step is main1 with an empty stack. Verify that Forge's mill cost checks library size before payment.

scenarios.title: An effect can refer to the milled card in the graveyard it moved to
decisions: A activates Charmed Pendant, tapping it and milling the top card of A's library as a cost.

variants.label: green_card
variants.expected: Cudgel Troll is milled into A's graveyard. Charmed Pendant adds one mana for each colored mana symbol in the milled card's cost ({2}{G}{G}), so A's mana pool holds {G}{G}.

variants.label: blue_card
variants.delta: The top card of A's library is Counterspell instead of Cudgel Troll.
variants.expected: Counterspell is milled into A's graveyard. A's mana pool holds {U}{U}.

variants.label: land_card
variants.delta: The top card of A's library is Forest instead of Cudgel Troll.
variants.expected: Forest is milled into A's graveyard. The land has no colored mana symbols, so A's mana pool stays empty.

scenarios.title: When a replacement effect mills several cards, the effect gets an answer for each milled card
decisions: A activates Charmed Pendant, tapping it and milling a card as a cost.
B's Bruvac the Grandiloquent replaces the mill; the mana ability resolves immediately.

variants.label: bruvac_doubles
variants.expected: Bruvac replaces milling one card with milling two: Cudgel Troll and Counterspell move to A's graveyard. Charmed Pendant gets information from each milled card, so A's mana pool holds {G}{G}{U}{U}.

variants.label: no_bruvac
variants.delta: B controls no Bruvac the Grandiloquent.
variants.expected: Only Cudgel Troll is milled. A's mana pool holds {G}{G} and Counterspell stays in A's library.

scenarios.forge_notes: Charmed Pendant's 'Special EachColoredManaSymbol_Milled' may only read one milled card in Forge; if so the doubled variant yields {G}{G} and Forge deviates from 701.17d.
